alex: Heads-up — ran into repeated OOMs on 4xA100 (tp=2) when serving long-context streams. Only happens under heavy concurrency + KV cache warmup. Log snippet:
alex: ```
RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory. Tried to allocate 256.00 MiB (GPU 2; total 40.00 GiB; free 1.2 GiB)
During NCCL allreduce: allocating comm buffer of 300MB -> OOM while KV cache pages still pinned
``` 
maya: Oof. Does this reproduce on a smaller job? can you attach the nsys trace or memstats snapshot?
alex: Repro is easy with our perf harness (batch=8, tokens=4096, concurrency=6). Pushing a trace now: `nsys profile -o /tmp/trace --trace=cuda,nccl python run_perf.py --tp 2 --kv-cache 24GB`
kai: Two quick hypotheses:
- NCCL allocs for comm bufs + per-shard temp tensors are not being accounted in our allocator's reserved region (they're coming in as ephemeral cudaMallocs and fragment the heap)
- Kernel selection path for large seq lengths is switching to a workspace-heavy attention kernel (flash-attn variant) that spikes transient workspace
kai: Workarounds to try in-prod: reduce concurrency OR limit sequence length OR force a different attention kernel via env override. Also try disabling prefix KV warmup caching on the first requests so we don't have pinned large KV pages + NCCL bufs at the same time.
oleg: Verified in the trace — at t=28s we see a burst of cudaMallocs from ncclCommAlloc + attention workspace, several ~200–350MB each. They overlap with KV writes. Screenshot: `nvprof` shows overlapping allocation events on multiple streams.
maria: From allocator perspective we should do two things:
1) Introduce a small per-GPU pre-reserved "comm" slab (e.g., 512MB) we hand out for NCCL/collectives so they don't trigger cudaMalloc at peak.
2) Make temporary workspace allocations reuse a dedicated workspace pool keyed by (device, kernel_id, required_size_bucket). That avoids fragmentation during kernel selection churn.
maya: Agree. Also noticed kernel selection toggles because our latency-cost heuristic tries a bigger kernel for long sequences after the first few runs — but it doesn't consider concurrent KV memory pressure. We need a signal: if free_memory < X then prefer the lower-workspace kernel even if slightly slower.
alex: Trying an experiment: set envs to cap NCCL temp to 128MB and enable kvcache-shared-reuse. Config snippet:
alex: ```json
{"runtime": {"comm_buffer_reserve": "128MB", "kv_cache_reuse": true, "workspace_pool_buckets": ["64MB","128MB","256MB","512MB"]}}
```
kai: Good. Also add an allocator debug metric that reports "ephemeral_cudamalloc_bytes" vs "pooled_alloc_bytes" over sliding window. That will show if nccl is bypassing pools.
oleg: On kernel side: the flash-attn route asks for a 384MB workspace for seq=4096 on our fused kernel. We can tweak kernel selector to cap requested workspace to pool max and fallback to non-fused kernel with 0 extra workspace.
maria: Implementation notes:
- Allocator: add reserve region and fallback order: pooled_alloc -> reserve_slab -> cudaMalloc
- Workspace pool: LIFO free lists per bucket to keep fragmentation low
- Selector: add memory-aware scoring term: score = latency_gain - beta * workspace_required/available_memory
maria: Beta tuning will need a perf sweep. Start with beta around 0.8 (penalize large workspace aggressively under pressure).
maya: For short-term mitigation: deploy a rolling change that reduces default concurrency for tp>=2 and sets comm_buffer_reserve=128MB. That should stop the OOMs until pools are in.
deploy-bot: Deployment queued: PR #4217 -> runtime/alloc: add comm_slab and workspace-pool (staged flag). Canary to 10% in 15m.
alex: After toggling reserve to 128MB, the repro didn't OOM for 20 runs but latency increased ~6% for the worst-case sequences. Acceptable short-term.
kai: Action items:
- [alex] collect nsys + nvprof traces for a couple more model sizes and upload to perf bucket
- [maria] prototype reserve slab + workspace pool (small PR)
- [oleg] add kernel-selector memory-aware scoring patch
- [maya] run canary with lowered concurrency and comm reserve enabled, report errors
- [maria,kai] add allocator debug metrics and dashboard (ephemeral vs pooled)

maria: One more thought — consider a KV cache "shadow" mode: allocate KV pages pinned but mark them as reclaimable for a short window (i.e., evict oldest prefix pages) to temporarily free space for comm bufs during allreduce. Might be complex but would reduce these collisions.
alex: Nice idea. For now we'll rely on reserve slab + selector change. Thanks all :thumbsup:
